Deprecate one version, or the whole component when no version is named.

A deprecated component cannot be newly installed or inserted, and a deprecated version cannot be
published in a paywall again; published paywalls keep working. --undo lifts the deprecation.

Usage:
  voidhash registry deprecate <component> [version] [flags]

Arguments:
  component  The registry component's id, such as acme/wheel-picker
  version    The version to deprecate (the whole component when omitted)

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --message <message>  Why, shown wherever the component is used
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
      --undo               Lift the deprecation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash registry deprecate acme/wheel-picker --message "Use acme/picker instead"
  voidhash registry deprecate acme/wheel-picker 1.2.0
  voidhash registry deprecate acme/wheel-picker 1.2.0 --undo
